appearance.title: Appearance settings
appearance.theme_description: System follows your operating system, light by day and dark by night if that's how you have it set.
appearance.who_to_follow_description: Three people you might want to follow, in the right column, or in your log on smaller screens.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language devnull is shown in. Commits stay in the language they were written in.

profile.title: Profile settings
profile.information_description: Mirrored from GitHub when you sign in. To change any of it, change it on GitHub, then sync it here.
profile.last_synced_at_sign_in: Last synced when you signed in
profile.export_description: Download everything we store about you: your profile, commits and replies (including pending, rejected, and deleted ones), stars, saved commits, follows, mutes, blocks, notifications, SSH key fingerprints, and active sessions.
profile.export_note: Other people's replies are excluded. Your export is a JSON file. Your profile is still managed on GitHub.

lane.title: Color
lane.description: Your lane on the graph: the rail and nodes beside your commits, the ring around your avatar, and the dot before your handle. Automatic picks one from your account id.

pasteis.title: Pastéis mode
pasteis.description: A little appreciation, fresh daily. Get 10 pastéis to give to other people’s commits, one per click. Your allowance resets at 00:00 UTC.
pasteis.off_note: When off, all pastéis controls and counters are hidden. You still receive pastéis from others.
pasteis.save_failed: Could not save pastéis mode. Please try again.

delete_account.title: Delete account
delete_account.description: Removes your /dev/null account, every commit and reply you've made, and everyone you follow. Replies others left under your commits go too. Replies under your replies stay, hanging off a [deleted] tombstone. Your GitHub account is not touched.
delete_account.confirm_description: Your profile, commits, replies, and follows go to /dev/null, along with every reply others left under your commits. Replies under your replies stay, under a [deleted] tombstone. This can't be undone. You can sign in with GitHub again later, but you'll start from zero.

safety.title: Safety settings
safety.muted_description: Their commits and replies stay out of your logs, threads, search, and suggestions, and they can't notify you. They aren't told, and you can still visit their profile.
safety.blocked_description: Neither of you can follow, reply to, or star the other, or see each other's commits. Unblocking doesn't bring back follows.

terminal.title: Terminal settings
terminal.from_terminal_description: No login, no token: the script signs your commit with an SSH key that is on your GitHub account, and /dev/null checks it against the keys GitHub publishes for you.
terminal.from_actions_description: Ship release notes when you publish a release, or anything else a workflow knows. Same signature, same moderation, same 10 commits a minute.
terminal.step_generate: Generate a key for CI only.
terminal.step_add_key_after: . It can sign /dev/null commits, but never push code or log in.
terminal.step_save_secret_middle: , the private key, as a repository secret named

inputs.ssh_key: The private key, from a secret. Ed25519 or RSA, without a passphrase.
inputs.reply_to: Optional. The hash or link of a commit to reply to.

terminal.job_output: The job prints the link to your commit, and whether it is pending review. When /dev/null refuses it, the job fails with the reason.

scheduled.title: Scheduled commits
scheduled.intro: Only you can see this list. At the scheduled time, each commit goes through the usual review process. Scheduling is not approval.
scheduled.empty_description: Choose Schedule in the composer to submit later.
scheduled.due_note: Waiting for the scheduler. If submission fails, it is retried automatically.
scheduled.private_note: Private until submitted. You can cancel before submission.
